["private.weekly_contact_source_logical_history_v1(uuid,text,uuid,uuid,bytea)","AGGREGATE_TYPE_UNCLASSIFIED","select min(x.accepted_at) into accepted from(
   select m.accepted_at_utc accepted_at from public.weekly_contact_delivery_memberships m
    where m.delivery_id=c.id and m.logical_contact_key=p_logical and m.send_ordinal=ordinal and m.accepted_at_utc is not null
   union all select c.provider_accepted_at_utc where c.provider_accepted_at_utc is not null
   union all select a.completed_at_utc from public.weekly_message_provider_attempts a
    where a.dispatch_command_id=c.id and a.outcome='ACCEPTED' and a.completed_at_utc is not null
   union all select a.completed_at_utc from public.weekly_message_dispatch_targets t join public.weekly_message_target_attempts a
    on a.dispatch_target_id=t.id where t.dispatch_command_id=c.id and a.outcome='ACCEPTED' and a.completed_at_utc is not null
  )x;"]

["private.weekly_contact_source_manager_followup_state_v1(uuid,timestamp with time zone)","AGGREGATE_TYPE_UNCLASSIFIED","select coalesce(max(capture_member.routine_step),0),count(distinct capture_member.routine_step) filter(where capture_member.routine_step>0)
  into completed,steps from public.weekly_contact_delivery_memberships accepted
  join public.weekly_message_dispatch_commands command on command.id=accepted.delivery_id
  join public.weekly_contact_source_intent_captures capture on capture.message_intent_id=command.message_intent_id
  join public.weekly_contact_source_intent_capture_members capture_member on capture_member.message_intent_id=capture.message_intent_id
   and capture_member.logical_contact_key=accepted.logical_contact_key and capture_member.send_ordinal=accepted.send_ordinal
  where accepted.logical_contact_key=decode(keys->>'logical_contact_key','hex') and accepted.accepted_at_utc is not null
   and capture.capture_kind in('ROUTINE_FOLLOWUP','ROUTINE_MANUAL_FOLLOWUP','FOLLOWUP_RECOMPOSITION','ROUTINE_MANUAL_SELECTION','MANUAL_SELECTION_RECOMPOSITION');"]

["private.weekly_contact_source_intent_current_subset_v1(uuid,timestamp with time zone)","AGGREGATE_TYPE_UNCLASSIFIED","if exists(select 1 from public.weekly_message_renders where message_intent_id=i.id) then
   select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('native_member_kind','MANAGER_MEMBER','incident_id',item.incident_id,
    'comparison_revision_id',item.sent_comparison_revision_id,'send_ordinal',1) order by item.id),'[]') into basis_members
    from public.weekly_message_renders render join public.weekly_manager_review_batches batch on batch.message_render_id=render.id
    join public.weekly_manager_review_items item on item.review_batch_id=batch.id where render.message_intent_id=i.id

       ((scope->>'client_id')::uuid,(scope->>'contract_id')::uuid,(scope->>'week_ending')::date)
